Class LogAppender.Appenders

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogAppender.Appenders
Enclosing interface:
LogAppender
public static class LogAppender.Appenders extends Object
Provides appenders safely to the publisher. The providing calls of asXXX can only be called once as they register the appenders.

    • asSingle

      public LogAppender asSingle() throws IllegalStateException
      Consolidate the appenders as a single appender, appended synchronously. If more than one appender is combined, each keeps its own independent lock and is appended to directly - see CompositeLogAppender.
      Returns:
      single appender.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if appenders are already registered.
